# fribidi for FlashVM / для FlashVM

Pinned sources, upstream license notices and generated data are in upstream/.
PROVENANCE.json records the source archive and SHA-256; flashvm.patch contains
all local adaptations. CMake builds fvm_fribidi as STATIC with FONTS.

See [integration and limits](../../doc/FONT_LIBRARIES.md) and
[профиль сборки и API](../../doc/FONT_LIBRARIES.ru.md).
Все исходники включены; сборка не требует сети или системной установки.
